name: ts-codemode-waiting
description: Comparable figures (FIG-7590): turn 1 keeps a 4 KB text and a list in session globals. Each later cell parks on one fixture_slow call that SIGKILLs every code-mode worker, so the run resumes cold on a fresh worker; its first statement after the park is a lookup. Three crashes stay under the pool's restart-storm bound.

cell: const notes = await tools.fixtureLarge({ key: "notes", bytes: 4096 });

turns.user: Turn {turn}: wait for item {turn} while the workers crash.

cell: const waited = await tools.fixtureSlow({ key: "wait-{turn}", ms: 5, kill_workers: true });
